svg.title: BladeCP cPanel Migrator architecture
svg.desc: On your cPanel and WHM server, WHM (root only) and the cPanel of each customer reach the plugin: the WHM plugin, with batches of up to 100 accounts, and the cPanel app, which goes through UAPI to a root AdminBin that acts only on the signed-in account. Both feed the queue and the API client. A cron runs the worker every minute, up to 4 migrations at a time, and the worker marks each account so that the cPanel home page banner hides once it migrates. For each account the worker makes a full pkgacct backup, without changing the account, and uploads it in resumable parts on signed links; the backup is deleted after the upload. The API client, with the partner key and root only, calls the BladeCP API at api.bladecp.com over HTTPS for the migration, the preview, the review and the approval. The partner WHMCS, with the BladeCP addon, links the owner, the service and the invoice. Pointing the domain is optional and never a step.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: From your WHM to the migrated site on BladeCP.
The source account is read and archived, never changed.
THE SOURCE ACCOUNT IS NEVER CHANGED
Root-only directory · settings, queue and logs

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: Preview and approval: BladeCP shows the migrated site on a preview link, and approving it completes the migration.
Each customer acts only on their own account: the AdminBin uses the account that cPanel authenticated.
